profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
If there's one thing I like best about computer science, it's that it's always pushing me to be better than I was. I am regularly challenged to not only learn new programming languages, but new ways of thinking; to write code that not only works, but that is fast and well-organized; to understand and apply concepts as an individual, but also in collaboration with others.

As programmer and aspiring software engineer, I tackle problems with determination and ingenuity, readily applying concepts and patterns to new situations. My experiences as tutor, freelancer, and teaching assistant have taught me to communicate and collaborate effectively with both peers and clients. I design solutions with a focus on the big-picture and implement solutions with an eye for detail.

Looking for a skilled, hard-working, and adaptable software engineer to add to your team? Please reach out!

projects.title: Family Map Server and App
projects.description:
Server handles HTTP requests and manages a database of ancestry data accordingly
Android app requests data from server and displays relationships between people and events
Skills used: Java, android development, database design

projects.title: Datalog Interpreter and Rule Evaluator
projects.description:
Program parses, interprets, and evaluates a datalog program
Rules are evaluated according to a dependency graph to increase program efficiency
Skills used: C++, discrete mathematics, algorithm design
